data.text/markdown:
Reuse the classifier in another notebook

This notebook imports compare_reviews() from the sentiment classifier notebook. You can now use it with a new set of reviews without copying the classification code. Make sure Ollama is running and that gemma3:1b and qwen3:1.7b are installed before you run the cells.
The import works like a normal Python import. Add the reviews you want to evaluate in the next cell.
texts contains three reviews that were not used in the first notebook. The next cell passes them to the imported comparison function.
